text: y receiving intravenous anesthesia were divided into three groups( Group P，with propofol TCI;Group E，with etomidate TCI;Group C with propofol－etomidate combination TCI) ． Using up－and－down sequential allocation methodology，the $\mathrm { E C } _ { 5 0 }$ of three groups was calculated，then Isobologram was drawn，and the changes of physiological indexes during colonoscopy was recorded． Results The $\mathrm { E C } _ { 5 0 }$ value of Group P was estimated to be 4． $1 5 \mu \mathrm { g } / \mathrm { m L }$ ［95% confidence interval ( CI) 3． 5 ～ 4． 8］，the $\mathrm { E C } _ { 5 0 }$ value of Group E was estimated to be 400 ng /mL ［95% confidence interval ( CI) 370 ～ 425］． The $\mathrm { E C } _ { 5 0 }$ values of P / E combination was estimated to be 1． 28 /220，The deviation of the location of $\mathrm { E C } _ { 5 0 }$ of P / E combination from the connecting line was statistically significant， $P { < } 0 . 0 5$ ． Conclusion The pharmacodynamic interaction between propofol and etomidate was synergetic．药物联合通过药代动力学和药效学机制产生相加、协同和拮抗作用，取长补短联合用药已成为临床麻醉的必然趋势 。
